_about: Golden record: the late annual refund from customer C1, followed through every seam it passes. Source: Docs/CB_Core_Pipeline_Design.md sections 5 and 11, and backend/tests/features/pipeline/e2e_lanes.feature E2E.02. Kafka seams hold full envelopes under messages. Synchronous seams hold calls with request and response. Temporal and SSE seams hold bare payloads. Each envelope's causation_id points to the event before it in this record. All times are UTC. All values are samples.
